Equilibrium temperature: T ∝ 1/√a (same star, same albedo).

So T1/T2 = √(a2/a1) = 1.4 → a2/a1 = 1.96
T2/T3 = √(a3/a2) = 2.3 → a3/a2 = 5.29

a3/a1 = 1.96 × 5.29 = 10.37

Period: P ∝ a^(3/2), so P3/P1 = (a3/a1)^(3/2) = 10.37^1.5

10.37^1.5 = 10.37 × √10.37 = 10.37 × 3.220 = 33.4

The masses are irrelevant (distractors). The "double the final total" warning refers to correctly using a3/a1 = product of the two ratios (not summing or mishandling), and computing the period correctly.

P3/P1 ≈ 33.4
